Spring-loaded seals are PTFE with an N10276 spring (−73 to 232 °C), or PTFE/graphite with an R30003 spring and PEEK anti-extrusion rings (−73 to 316 °C, with a 260 °C maximum in oxidizing service). {"tool":"datasheet","tag":"FV-106-2","question":"Which seal or piston ring materials are available, and what temperatures are they good for?"}

Tool result:
Datasheet fisher-et-d100022x012, pages [20, 21, 7, 15, 12, 14, 13, 18]:
The datasheet lists several seal materials, with temperature limits that depend on the seal type and service. It also lists UHMWPE for the Class VI seal ring; the stated temperature limit is for the complete trim combination, not the ring alone.

- **Two-piece valve plug seal** (standard on NPS 1–6 valves except those with Cavitrol III cages): carbon-filled PTFE, **−73 to 232 °C (−100 to 450 °F)**; ethylene-propylene, **−40 to 232 °C (−40 to 450 °F)**; fluorocarbon, **−18 to 204 °C (0 to 400 °F)**; or nitrile, **−40 to 71 °C (−40 to 160 °F)** for air and hydrocarbons, and **−40 to 82 °C (−40 to 180 °F)** for other compatible fluids. The datasheet says fluorocarbon is not for steam or ammonia and is not recommended for water above **82 °C (180 °F)**; nitrile cannot be used with fire-resistant hydraulic oils. [p. 20]
- **Spring-loaded valve plug seal:** PTFE with an N10276 spring, **−73 to 232 °C (−100 to 450 °F)**. For use with PEEK anti-extrusion rings, PTFE/graphite with an R30003 spring is listed at **−73 to 316 °C (−100 to 600 °F)**, but its maximum is **260 °C (500 °F) in oxidizing service**. The datasheet says PEEK itself is “not limiting factors.” [p. 20]
- **PTFE V-ring:** **−40 to 232 °C (−40 to 450 °F)**. [p. 20]
- **Class VI seal ring:** UHMWPE (Ultra High Molecular Weight Polyethylene), **−29 to 66 °C (−20 to 150 °F)** with a 17-4 stainless-steel cage and S41600 plug; **−198 to 66 °C (−325 to 150 °F)** with a 316 stainless-steel/ENC cage. These are trim-combination limits. [p. 7]

For the spring-loaded seal with PEEK anti-extrusion rings, the datasheet also notes that the parts are not used with ports **137 mm (7 in.) or larger**. [p. 20]
